description: Composition by rule on music21: a seeded harmony planner (roman-numeral progressions with sevenths, applied dominants, the Neapolitan and the Italian, French and German sixths, five cadence types and pivot-chord modulation) voiced in SATB, a voice-leading checker (parallels, hidden fifths and octaves, crossing, overlap, spacing, ranges, unresolved leading tones and sevenths), a figured-bass realizer, species counterpoint one to five above or below a cantus firmus, invertible counterpoint at the octave, tenth and twelfth, canons at any interval and lag, and fugue expositions with tonal answers, countersubjects, sequential episodes and a stretto search. Chords sit on the roll's meter map, notes in 960 PPQ ticks. No model.
